description: This file defines the CacheInterface interface in the Psr\SimpleCache namespace, specifying the standard methods for cache operations such as get, set, delete, clear, and checks for key existence, along with handling multiple keys.

classes.name: CacheInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the standard cache operations for PSR-16 compatible cache implementations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a value from the cache by key, returning default if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an item from the cache by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cache.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their keys.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in the cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their keys.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache item exists by key.
